0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 12th in the East) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-5, four straight losses, 12th in the West) in the Magic's eighth game of the season, with Orlando 0-4 at home and 2-1 on the road. Orlando is missing Paolo Banchero, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda, and Izaiyah Nelson, while Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams, and Rasheer Fleming. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the last meeting, on March 31, 2026 in Orlando, went the Magic's way 115-111, with no games yet this season.
